returns.name: Quarterly unemployment insurance report and tax payment (WYUI)
contents: Due April 30, July 31, October 31 and January 31; the delinquent date is the next day (May 1, August 1, November 1, February 1). When the date is a weekend or holiday the due date is the next business day.
Reports are filed and amended in the WYUI portal, which also shows wages, rates (current and past), payments, balances and credits; taxes are paid online or by check with a printed voucher coupon.
The portal also carries workers' compensation reporting for employers that need it.

notModelled: Wyoming has no state income tax on wages, so there is no state withholding.
